title: Establishment of a Registry of Patients With Parathyroid Disease
official: Establishment of a Registry of Patients With Parathyroid Disease
summary: Establishment of a registry with which to census all patients under the care of the O.U. Endocrinology for parathyroid pathology in order to longitudinally evaluate biochemical, clinical, radiological, medico-nuclear and histological data in future studies.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age ≥18 years
* Diagnosis of hyperparathyroidism or hypoparathyroidism based on biochemical parameters (calcemia, parathormone, phosphormia, creatinine, albumin, vitamin D25OH)
* Obtaining informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* none
